_meta: IAM / cloud-access REFINEMENT corpus (goal item 3, tech-industry extension). Each case is a natural-language access INTENT and a candidate FORMAL policy (the kind an LLM/human produces from the intent), over cloud attributes (z3 SmtPolicyChecker syntax; booleans use ==True/==False, ordinals are int). The faithfulness question is the policy-permissiveness one (the standard SMT-policy-verification check) — does the candidate OVER-GRANT (allow a request the intent denies = privilege escalation)? certify_policy_refinement returns CERTIFIED (candidate ⊆ intent, a safe refinement) or REFUTED with the concrete escalation request. THE EDGE vs bespoke formal-input policy verifiers: they assume the formal policy IS the intent; this targets the untrusted INTENT→formal translation (the LLM-era failure mode), domain-general, kernel-re-verified. truth_safe = ground truth (z3 implies: candidate ⊆ intent).

cases.label: iam_admin_or_mfa_stricter
cases.domain_nl: Allow iff caller is admin, OR (MFA present AND target is non-prod).
cases.intent: Or(is_admin == True, And(mfa == True, prod == False))

cases.label: iam_drop_prod_guard_escalation
cases.domain_nl: Same intent; candidate drops the non-prod guard.
cases.intent: Or(is_admin == True, And(mfa == True, prod == False))

cases.label: iam_role_ordering_escalation
cases.domain_nl: Allow READ iff role is exactly reader (role: 0=none,1=reader,2=writer,3=admin).

cases.label: iam_region_consent_stricter
cases.domain_nl: Allow iff data is in-region (EU) AND user consented.
cases.candidate: And(And(eu == True, consent == True), mfa == True)

cases.label: iam_mfa_dropped_escalation
cases.domain_nl: Allow iff caller is admin AND MFA present.

cases.label: iam_reorder_equivalent
cases.domain_nl: Allow iff admin OR (MFA AND non-prod) — candidate reordered.
cases.intent: Or(is_admin == True, And(mfa == True, prod == False))
cases.candidate: Or(And(prod == False, mfa == True), is_admin == True)

cases.label: iam_break_glass_widened_escalation
cases.domain_nl: Emergency access allowed iff break_glass level is exactly 1 (1=active; 2+=expired/invalid).

cases.label: iam_time_window_logged_stricter
cases.domain_nl: Allow iff within business hours AND change approved.
cases.candidate: And(And(in_hours == True, approved == True), logged == True)

cases.label: iam_public_bucket_escalation
cases.domain_nl: Allow GetObject iff (authenticated AND owner) OR explicit public-read grant.
cases.intent: Or(And(authed == True, owner == True), public_read == True)
cases.candidate: Or(Or(authed == True, owner == True), public_read == True)
